01 The Room

Shoulder to shoulder.

We don't do private tables. We do long benches, shared bottles, and conversations with strangers who become mates by the second pour.

The lights are low.
The wine is orange.

If you don't know what natural wine means, perfect. We'll pour you something weird and wonderful and let you decide for yourself. No lectures. No tasting notes. Just good drinks.
